Algebra.subject: Computer & IT
Algebra.question: What is Algebra? Branch of mathematics.
Algebra.fact: Algebra is a branch of mathematics that deals with abstract systems, called algebraic structures, and the manipulation of expressions within those systems.   It is a generalization of arithmetic that introduces variables and algebraic operations other than the standard arithmetic operations, such as addition and multiplication.

Algebraic data type.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic data type.question: The _____ was Data type defined by combining other types.
Algebraic data type.fact: In computer programming, especially in functional programming and type theory, an algebraic data type (ADT) is a composite data type, i.e. An algebraic data type is defined by two key constructions: a sum and a product.

Algebraic data type.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic data type.question: For example, a type representing the state of a traffic light could be either Red, _____, or Green
Algebraic data type.fact: For example, a type representing the state of a traffic light could be either Red, Amber, or Green.

Algebraic data type.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic data type.question: A shape type could be either a _____ (which stores a radius) or a Square (which stores a width)
Algebraic data type.fact: A shape type could be either a Circle (which stores a radius) or a Square (which stores a width).

Algebraic data type.fact: For example, a Point type might be defined to contain an x coordinate (an integer) and a y coordinate (also an integer).

Algebraic data type.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic data type.question: The set of all possible values of a product type is the _____ product of the sets of its component types
Algebraic data type.fact: The set of all possible values of a product type is the Cartesian product of the sets of its component types.

Algebraic data type.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic data type.question: A list type is a sum type with two variants, Nil for an empty list and _____ x xs for the combination of a new element x with a list xs to create a new list
Algebraic data type.fact: This feature allows a programmer to check which constructor a value was made with and extract the data it contains in a convenient and type-safe way. Algebraic Eraser.question: What is Algebraic Eraser? Cryptographic protocol.
Algebraic Eraser.fact: Algebraic Eraser (AE) is an anonymous key agreement protocol that allows two parties, each having an AE public–private key pair, to establish a shared secret over an insecure channel. Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The _____ was Subject area in mathematics.
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Algebraic K-theory is a subject area in mathematics with connections to geometry, topology, ring theory, and number theory.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: K-theory was discovered in the late 1950s by _____ in his study of intersection theory on algebraic varieties
Algebraic K-theory.fact: K-theory was discovered in the late 1950s by Alexander Grothendieck in his study of intersection theory on algebraic varieties.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In the modern language, _____ defined only K0, the zeroth K-group, but even this single group has plenty of applications, such as the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem
Algebraic K-theory.fact: K-theory was discovered in the late 1950s by Alexander Grothendieck in his study of intersection theory on algebraic varieties. In the modern language, Grothendieck defined only K0, the zeroth K-group, but even this single group has plenty of applications, such as the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: For a commutative ring R, the group K0(R) is related to the _____ group of R, and when R is the ring of integers in a number field, this generalizes the classical construction of the class group
Algebraic K-theory.fact: For a commutative ring R, the group K0(R) is related to the Picard group of R, and when R is the ring of integers in a number field, this generalizes the classical construction of the class group.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: For a number field F, the group K2(F) is related to class field theory, the _____ symbol, and the solvability of quadratic equations over completions
Algebraic K-theory.fact: For a number field F, the group K2(F) is related to class field theory, the Hilbert symbol, and the solvability of quadratic equations over completions.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: If X is a _____ surface, then the sets of meromorphic functions and meromorphic differential forms on X form vector spaces
Algebraic K-theory.fact: If X is a Riemann surface, then the sets of meromorphic functions and meromorphic differential forms on X form vector spaces. The Riemann–Roch theorem states that the difference in dimensions between these subspaces is equal to the degree of the line bundle (a measure of twistedness) plus one minus the genus of X. In the mid-20th century, the Riemann–Roch theorem was generalized by Friedrich Hirzebruch to all algebraic varieties.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The subject of K-theory takes its name from a _____ construction of Alexander Grothendieck which appeared in the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem, his generalization of Hirzebruch's theorem
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The subject of K-theory takes its name from a 1957 construction of Alexander Grothendieck which appeared in the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem, his generalization of Hirzebruch's theorem.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The subject of K-theory takes its name from a 1957 construction of _____ which appeared in the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem, his generalization of Hirzebruch's theorem
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The subject of K-theory takes its name from a 1957 construction of Alexander Grothendieck which appeared in the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem, his generalization of Hirzebruch's theorem.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: To each vector bundle on X, _____ associates an invariant, its class
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The subject of K-theory takes its name from a 1957 construction of Alexander Grothendieck which appeared in the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem, his generalization of Hirzebruch's theorem. To each vector bundle on X, Grothendieck associates an invariant, its class.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The set of all classes on X was called K(X) from the _____
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The set of all classes on X was called K(X) from the German Klasse.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Grothendieck took the perspective that the _____–Roch theorem is a statement about morphisms of varieties, not the varieties themselves
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Grothendieck took the perspective that the Riemann–Roch theorem is a statement about morphisms of varieties, not the varieties themselves.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: When Y is a point, a vector bundle is a vector space, the class of a vector space is its dimension, and the _____–Riemann–Roch theorem specializes to Hirzebruch's theorem
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem says that these are equal. When Y is a point, a vector bundle is a vector space, the class of a vector space is its dimension, and the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem specializes to Hirzebruch's theorem.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Atiyah and _____ quickly transported Grothendieck's construction to topology and used it to define topological K-theory
Algebraic K-theory.fact: When Y is a point, a vector bundle is a vector space, the class of a vector space is its dimension, and the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch theorem specializes to Hirzebruch's theorem. Atiyah and Hirzebruch quickly transported Grothendieck's construction to topology and used it to define topological K-theory.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: His methods, however, had a serious gap: _____é could not prove that two triangulations of a manifold always yielded the same Betti numbers
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Henri Poincaré had attempted to define the Betti numbers of a manifold in terms of a triangulation. His methods, however, had a serious gap: Poincaré could not prove that two triangulations of a manifold always yielded the same Betti numbers.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: This hypothesis became a conjecture known as the _____ (roughly "main conjecture")
Algebraic K-theory.fact: This hypothesis became a conjecture called the Hauptvermutung (roughly "main conjecture").

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The fact that triangulations were stable under subdivision led J.H.C. _____ to introduce the notion of simple homotopy type
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The fact that triangulations were stable under subdivision led J.H.C. Whitehead to introduce the notion of simple homotopy type. Whitehead proved that simple homotopy equivalence is a finer invariant than homotopy equivalence by introducing an invariant called the torsion.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The torsion of a homotopy equivalence takes values in a group now called the _____ group and denoted Wh(π), where π is the fundamental group of the target complex
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Whitehead proved that simple homotopy equivalence is a finer invariant than homotopy equivalence by introducing an invariant called the torsion. The torsion of a homotopy equivalence takes values in a group now called the Whitehead group and denoted Wh(π), where π is the fundamental group of the target complex.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Later John Milnor used _____ torsion, an invariant related to Whitehead torsion, to disprove the Hauptvermutung
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Later John Milnor used Reidemeister torsion, an invariant related to Whitehead torsion, to disprove the Hauptvermutung.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The first adequate definition of K1 of a ring was made by _____ and Stephen Schanuel
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The first adequate definition of K1 of a ring was made by Hyman Bass and Stephen Schanuel.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In addition to providing a coherent exposition of the results then known, _____ improved many of the statements of the theorems
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Motivated by this, the Bass–Schanuel definition of K1 of a ring R is GL(R) / E(R), where GL(R) is the infinite general linear group (the union of all GLn(R)) and E(R) is the subgroup of elementary matrices. Work in K-theory from this period culminated in Bass' book Algebraic K-theory.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In independent work, _____ gave another definition of negative K-groups for certain categories and proved that his definitions yielded that same groups as those of Bass
Algebraic K-theory.fact: In independent work, Max Karoubi gave another definition of negative K-groups for certain categories and proved that his definitions yielded that same groups as those of Bass.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Steinberg studied the universal central extensions of a _____ group over a field and gave an explicit presentation of this group in terms of generators and relations
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Steinberg studied the universal central extensions of a Chevalley group over a field and gave an explicit presentation of this group in terms of generators and relations.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In the case of the group En(k) of elementary matrices, the universal central extension is now written Stn(k) and called the _____ group
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Steinberg studied the universal central extensions of a Chevalley group over a field and gave an explicit presentation of this group in terms of generators and relations. In the case of the group En(k) of elementary matrices, the universal central extension is now written Stn(k) and called the Steinberg group.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In the spring of _____, John Milnor defined K2(R) to be the kernel of the homomorphism St(R) → E(R)
Algebraic K-theory.fact: In the spring of 1967, John Milnor defined K2(R) to be the kernel of the homomorphism St(R) → E(R).

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In the spring of 1967, _____ defined K2(R) to be the kernel of the homomorphism St(R) → E(R)
Algebraic K-theory.fact: In the spring of 1967, John Milnor defined K2(R) to be the kernel of the homomorphism St(R) → E(R).

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Hideya Matsumoto's _____ thesis showed that for a field F, K2(F) was isomorphic to: F × ⊗ Z F × / ⟨ x ⊗ ( 1 − x ) : x ∈ F ∖ { 0 , 1 } ⟩
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Hideya Matsumoto's 1968 thesis showed that for a field F, K2(F) was isomorphic to: F × ⊗ Z F × / ⟨ x ⊗ ( 1 − x ) : x ∈ F ∖ { 0 , 1 } ⟩.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In particular, _____ was able to prove that K2(Q) is essentially structured around the law of quadratic reciprocity
Algebraic K-theory.fact: In particular, John Tate was able to prove that K2(Q) is essentially structured around the law of quadratic reciprocity.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Swan and _____ both produced definitions of Kn for all n, and Gersten proved that his and Swan's theories were equivalent, but the two theories were not known to satisfy all the expected properties
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Swan and Gersten both produced definitions of Kn for all n, and Gersten proved that his and Swan's theories were equivalent, but the two theories were not known to satisfy all the expected properties.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Nobile and _____ also proposed a definition of higher K-groups
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Nobile and Villamayor also proposed a definition of higher K-groups. Karoubi and Villamayor defined well-behaved K-groups for all n, but their equivalent of K1 was sometimes a proper quotient of the Bass–Schanuel K1.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Karoubi and _____ defined well-behaved K-groups for all n, but their equivalent of K1 was sometimes a proper quotient of the Bass–Schanuel K1
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Nobile and Villamayor also proposed a definition of higher K-groups. Karoubi and Villamayor defined well-behaved K-groups for all n, but their equivalent of K1 was sometimes a proper quotient of the Bass–Schanuel K1.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Inspired in part by _____'s theorem, Milnor made a definition of the higher K-groups of a field
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Inspired in part by Matsumoto's theorem, Milnor made a definition of the higher K-groups of a field.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Much later, it was discovered by _____ and Suslin and by Totaro that Milnor K-theory is actually a direct summand of the true K-theory of the field
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Much later, it was discovered by Nesterenko and Suslin and by Totaro that Milnor K-theory is actually a direct summand of the true K-theory of the field.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Specifically, K-groups have a filtration called the weight filtration, and the _____ K-theory of a field is the highest weight-graded piece of the K-theory
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Inspired in part by Matsumoto's theorem, Milnor made a definition of the higher K-groups of a field. Much later, it was discovered by Nesterenko and Suslin and by Totaro that Milnor K-theory is actually a direct summand of the true K-theory of the field.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Additionally, _____ discovered that there is no analog of Milnor K-theory for a general variety
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Additionally, Thomason discovered that there is no analog of Milnor K-theory for a general variety.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The first definition of higher K-theory to be widely accepted was _____'s
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The first definition of higher K-theory to be widely accepted was Daniel Quillen's.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The Adams operations had been known to be related to Chern classes and to K-theory since the work of _____, and so Quillen was led to define the K-theory of R as the homotopy groups of BGL(R)+
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The Adams operations had been known to be related to Chern classes and to K-theory since the work of Grothendieck, and so Quillen was led to define the K-theory of R as the homotopy groups of BGL(R)+.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Not only did this recover K1 and K2, the relation of K-theory to the Adams operations allowed _____ to compute the K-groups of finite fields
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The Adams operations had been known to be related to Chern classes and to K-theory since the work of Grothendieck, and so Quillen was led to define the K-theory of R as the homotopy groups of BGL(R)+. Not only did this recover K1 and K2, the relation of K-theory to the Adams operations allowed Quillen to compute the K-groups of finite fields.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: The classifying space BGL is connected, so _____'s definition failed to give the correct value for K0
Algebraic K-theory.fact: The Adams operations had been known to be related to Chern classes and to K-theory since the work of Grothendieck, and so Quillen was led to define the K-theory of R as the homotopy groups of BGL(R)+. Not only did this recover K1 and K2, the relation of K-theory to the Adams operations allowed Quillen to compute the K-groups of finite fields.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Segal's approach is a homotopy analog of _____'s construction of K0
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Segal's approach is a homotopy analog of Grothendieck's construction of K0. Where Grothendieck worked with isomorphism classes of bundles, Segal worked with the bundles themselves and used isomorphisms of the bundles as part of his data.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: However, _____'s approach was only able to impose relations for split exact sequences, not general exact sequences
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Segal's approach is a homotopy analog of Grothendieck's construction of K0. Where Grothendieck worked with isomorphism classes of bundles, Segal worked with the bundles themselves and used isomorphisms of the bundles as part of his data.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Where Grothendieck worked with isomorphism classes of bundles, _____ worked with the bundles themselves and used isomorphisms of the bundles as part of his data
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Inspired by conversations with Quillen, Segal soon introduced another approach to constructing algebraic K-theory under the name of Γ-objects. Segal's approach is a homotopy analog of Grothendieck's construction of K0.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: In the spring of _____, Quillen found another approach to the construction of higher K-theory which was to prove enormously successful
Algebraic K-theory.fact: In the spring of 1972, Quillen found another approach to the construction of higher K-theory which was to prove enormously successful.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: From this he constructed an auxiliary category using a new device called his "Q-construction." _____'s Γ-objects, the Q-construction has its roots in Grothendieck's definition of K0

Unlike Grothendieck's definition, however, the Q-construction builds a category, not an abelian group, and unlike Segal's Γ-objects, the Q-construction works directly with short exact sequences.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: Additionally, it was possible to prove that the earlier definitions of Swan and _____ were equivalent to Quillen's under certain conditions
Algebraic K-theory.fact: Additionally, it was possible to prove that the earlier definitions of Swan and Gersten were equivalent to Quillen's under certain conditions.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT
Algebraic K-theory.question: G-theory had been defined early in the development of the subject by _____
Algebraic K-theory.fact: G-theory had been defined early in the development of the subject by Grothendieck. Grothendieck defined G0(X) for a variety X to be the free abelian group on isomorphism classes of coherent sheaves on X, modulo relations coming from exact sequences of coherent sheaves.

Algebraic K-theory.subject: Computer & IT

Algebraic K-theory.fact: A closely related construction was found by C. T. C. Wall in 1963.

Algebraic K-theory.question: Laurent Siebenmann in his thesis found an invariant similar to _____'s that gives an obstruction to an open manifold being the interior of a compact manifold with boundary
Algebraic K-theory.fact: A closely related construction was found by C. T. C. Wall in 1963. Wall found that a space X dominated by a finite complex has a generalized Euler characteristic taking values in a quotient of K0(Zπ), where π is the fundamental group of the space.

Almost perfect number.fact: In mathematics, an almost perfect number (sometimes also called slightly defective or least deficient number) is a natural number n such that the sum of all divisors of n (the sum-of-divisors function σ(n)) is equal to 2n − 1, the sum of all proper divisors of n, s(n) = σ(n) − n, then being equal to n − 1.
